title: Promote review feedback into a hard invariant with provenance
narrative: Repeated review feedback becomes an experiment, then a soft instruction, then a hard invariant — always with source permalink and rollback evidence. Accepts WalkingLabs L10 and L12 guidance[^wl-l10-promo][^wl-l12-promo].
implementation: `PromotionRecord`, `promote_soft_to_hard`, and `rollback_promotion` in `mechaharness.rule_promotion` model the promotion chain.
